name: Arc carbine
description: A precise ion burst. A percentile roll resolves accuracy and critical damage.

name: Synapse surge
description: Overload an enemy's nervous mesh. Deals damage and interrupts it for 3 seconds.

name: Bloom protocol
description: Repair yourself and nearby linked allies with a cloud of living nanofibers.

name: Kinetic veil
description: Store incoming damage in a temporary kinetic shield. Draw nearby enemy attention.

name: Rail lance
description: A capacitor-driven tungsten lance for distant targets.

name: Echo collapse
description: Collapse a synthetic afterimage, damaging enemies around your target.

name: Ghostline
description: Move 12 m over at least 2 seconds, then replay up to 6 seconds of your route. Cross the cyan runner to release a shockwave, recover 20 energy, and reset your dash. Another player crossing it gives 50% more power and restores both runners. Arms after 0.6 seconds.
